summary: Adopted four fixes: manifests now record whose voice viewers hear (the hook's voice and the narrator's share of words), list videos can get three different thumbnail types, render.json reports the real tempo, and a falling value shows as -$19,470 and is read as 'minus'. All five experiments still wait for data.
why: Nothing matured (all five experiments short of their per-arm minimum) and experiments are at the cap of 5, so no new A/B. One research adopt/high item and three Scout adopt bugs were ready and inside the improver's lane.

findings.title: 25 videos have 48 h data
findings.detail: quiet-bed 1 of 4 long per arm, hook-voice-matches-frame 3 of 8, title-names-the-moment 1 of 8, chart-gap-fill 0 of 4, loop-picture-matches-hook 0 of 8: all wait.

findings.title: Who speaks matters more than the narrator's name
findings.detail: From the scripts: Shorts opened by Sharma (am_fenrir) 15.8x median 48 h views (n=4, 79% viewed); narrator under 25% of words 31.2x (n=3) vs narrator 75-100% 0.66x (n=5). Supports research's cast-voices-the-story, queued for the next free slot.

findings.title: Music and length
findings.detail: cinematic 30.8x (n=3, 96% viewed), 25-29 s Shorts 17.1x (n=4, 82% viewed); myth hooks 0.33x (n=5, 24.5%).

findings.title: Formats
findings.detail: Only rule_change has 3+ Shorts (n=3, 42.9% viewed): not under the median, nothing retired.

changes.title: Manifest field heard {hookVoice, narratorShare}
changes.detail: generator/run.py heard(); ranking in the evaluator needs the owner (notification).

changes.title: list_explained thumbnails: grid, face or scene
changes.detail: renderer/thumbs.py; test that every format allows 3 types.

changes.title: render.json tempo
changes.detail: renderer/remotion.py reports the timeline's tempo instead of 1.0.

changes.title: Negative money: sign before the currency
changes.detail: formatting.py and remotion/src/fmt/inr.ts (parity fixtures with negatives), voice reads 'minus', long_story README notes negative rate_pct.
